vocabularies.definition: IELTS Paraphrase: 'There is no charge for entry, although donations are welcomed.'
vocabularies.example: There is free admission to the museum on weekdays.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Masuk museum gratis pada hari kerja biasa.
vocabularies.notes: Context: Local Museum (Part 2). Jebakan IELTS: kata 'donations' sering membuat peserta ragu apakah gratis atau berbayar.

vocabularies.definition: IELTS Paraphrase: 'Designed entirely by young people who attended the summer workshop.'
vocabularies.example: The artwork was created by students from the local college.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Karya seni tersebut dibuat oleh para siswa dari perguruan tinggi setempat.
vocabularies.notes: Context: Art Gallery (Part 2). 'Students' diparafrase menjadi 'young people who attended the course/workshop'.

vocabularies.definition: IELTS Paraphrase: 'Open every day of the week except at the very start.'
vocabularies.example: The city library is closed on Mondays for staff maintenance.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Perpustakaan kota tutup pada hari Senin untuk pemeliharaan staf.
vocabularies.notes: Context: City Library (Part 2). Jebakan 'except at the very start of the week' = closed on Mondays.

vocabularies.definition: IELTS Paraphrase: 'All new members are strictly required to attend.'
vocabularies.example: Attendance at the orientation session is mandatory for all freshmen.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Kehadiran pada sesi orientasi bersifat wajib bagi semua mahasiswa baru.
vocabularies.notes: Context: Campus Facility (Part 3). Sinonim: mandatory = compulsory = required = obliged to attend.

vocabularies.definition: IELTS Paraphrase: 'The interior was fully refurbished and updated only last month.'
vocabularies.example: The sports centre was recently renovated with modern gym equipment.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Pusat olahraga baru saja direnovasi dengan peralatan gym modern.
vocabularies.notes: Context: Sports Centre (Part 2). 'Renovated' diparafrase menjadi 'refurbished / modernised'.

vocabularies.definition: IELTS Paraphrase: 'There are only a handful of car spots available for visitors.'
vocabularies.example: Visitors are advised to take public transit due to limited parking space.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Pengunjung disarankan menggunakan angkutan umum karena tempat parkir yang terbatas.
vocabularies.notes: Context: Town Hall / Event Venue (Part 2). 'Limited' sering diparafrase: 'only a handful of', 'restricted number of'.

vocabularies.meaning: Membeli tiket terlebih dahulu / di muka
vocabularies.definition: IELTS Paraphrase: 'You need to book your place online ahead of time.'
vocabularies.example: You should buy tickets in advance to secure a seat for the concert.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Anda sebaiknya membeli tiket di muka untuk mengamankan kursi konser.
vocabularies.notes: Context: Theatre Box Office (Part 2). 'In advance' = 'ahead of time' = 'prior to arrival'.

vocabularies.definition: IELTS Paraphrase: 'Ideal if you have never tried this activity before.'
vocabularies.example: This yoga class is suitable for beginners of all ages.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Kelas yoga ini cocok untuk pemula dari segala usia.
vocabularies.notes: Context: Community Sports Club (Part 2). Sering menjadi opsi benar melawan opsi jebakan 'for advanced athletes'.

vocabularies.definition: IELTS Paraphrase: 'Parties of ten or more will receive a special discount.'
vocabularies.example: The museum offers a reduced price for school groups.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Museum menawarkan potongan harga khusus untuk rombongan sekolah.
vocabularies.notes: Context: Heritage Castle (Part 2). 'Groups' sering diparafrase menjadi 'parties of [number] or more'.

vocabularies.definition: IELTS Paraphrase: 'We initially planned to start this week, but it has been put off until December.'
vocabularies.example: The public lecture has been postponed until next month.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Kuliah umum telah ditunda hingga bulan depan.
vocabularies.notes: Context: University Lecture Hall (Part 2/3). Distractor waktu: pembicara menyebut 'this week' lalu meralat 'put off / delayed'.

vocabularies.definition: IELTS Paraphrase: 'Visitors must refrain from consuming snacks or drinks inside.'
vocabularies.example: Eating is not permitted in the computer lab.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Makan tidak diizinkan di dalam lab komputer.
vocabularies.notes: Context: Science Exhibition (Part 2). 'Not permitted' = 'strictly forbidden' = 'must refrain from'.

vocabularies.definition: IELTS Paraphrase: 'Right beside the main welcome desk as you walk through the doors.'
vocabularies.example: The cloakroom is located next to the reception counter.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Ruang penitipan barang terletak di sebelah meja resepsionis.
vocabularies.notes: Context: Campus Information Desk (Part 2 Map Labelling). 'Next to' = 'adjacent to' = 'right beside'.

vocabularies.definition: IELTS Paraphrase: 'Participants are expected to supply their own sports gear.'
vocabularies.example: You are required to bring your own equipment to the tennis workshop.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Anda diwajibkan membawa peralatan sendiri ke lokakarya tenis.
vocabularies.notes: Context: Recreation Centre (Part 2). Jebakan: pembicara menyebut 'we have spares for rent', namun opsi resmi tetap 'bring own gear'.

vocabularies.definition: IELTS Paraphrase: 'We originally chose solar power, but we decided to switch to plastic recycling.'
vocabularies.example: The tutor approved our change of topic for the final presentation.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Dosen pembimbing menyetujui perubahan topik kami untuk presentasi akhir.
vocabularies.notes: Context: Tutor Consultation (Part 3). Pola klasik Part 3: Ide pertama disebut panjang lebar hanya sebagai distraktor sebelum sepakat berubah pikiran.

vocabularies.definition: IELTS Paraphrase: 'The campus shuttle operates Monday through Friday, not over the weekend.'
vocabularies.example: The library reference room is available on weekdays only.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Ruang referensi perpustakaan hanya tersedia pada hari kerja.
vocabularies.notes: Context: University Facility (Part 2). Sering digunakan untuk menjebak siswa yang mengira hari Sabtu buka setengah hari.
